Embedded font-family names (`word/fontTable.xml`) were interpolated unescaped into an injected `@font-face` `<style>` and into the print window's `document.write()`. A crafted name injects page-wide CSS on open, and breaks out of `<style>`
  into executable HTML on Print.

## Impact
Opening a crafted `.docx` applies attacker-controlled CSS page-wide with zero clicks (overlay/phishing, attribute-selector exfiltration of input values, tracking beacons). Clicking Print escalates to script execution in the embedder's origin.

## Remediation
Upgrade to 1.8.3. Font names are CSS-escaped before interpolation (quotes, backslash, `< >`, and CSS newlines), and the print window is assembled with DOM APIs instead of `document.write`.", "ghsa_id": "GHSA-x7m8-jrm8-hpvx", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-09-10T15:06:16Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-x7m8-jrm8-hpvx", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-x7m8-jrm8-hpvx"}], "nvd_published_at": null, "published_at": "2026-09-10T15:06:16Z", "references": ["https://github.com/eigenpal/docx-editor/security/advisories/GHSA-x7m8-jrm8-hpvx", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-x7m8-jrm8-hpvx"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/eigenpal/docx-editor-old/security-advisories/GHSA-x7m8-jrm8-hpvx", "severity": "high", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/eigenpal/docx-editor", "summary": "@eigenpal/docx-editor-react: CSS injection and print-time XSS via unescaped embedded font-family name", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-09-10T15:06:17Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-x7m8-jrm8-hpvx", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "1.8.3", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "@eigenpal/docx-editor-core"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "<= 1.8.2"}, {"first_patched_version": "1.8.3", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "@eigenpal/docx-editor-react"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": "<= 1.8.2"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
